name: Move's preview in the move sandbox, blocked: a junction in the folder browser and in what moves (move.reparse-point), and a file open in another program (move.in-use, then Check again). Needs the junctions Movies\Link Folder and Movies\Plain Loose (2005).trickplay, and a process holding Movies\Tagged Loose (2003) [tmdbid-910003].mkv open for about two minutes: scripts/Set-MoveBlockedFixture.ps1 -Action Setup before, -Action Remove after (scripts/README.md)

steps.script: const u = ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(); const q = async (o) => (await ApiClient.getItems(u, Object.assign({ Recursive: true }, o))).Items; const views = (await ApiClient.getUserViews({}, u)).Items; const view = (n) => (views.find((v) => v.Name === n) || {}).Id; const m1 = await q({ ParentId: view('Movies'), IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie' }); const m2 = await q({ ParentId: view('Movies 2'), IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Fields: 'MediaSources' }); const eps = await q({ ParentId: view('Shows'), IncludeItemTypes: 'Episode' }); const by = (list, name) => list.find((i) => i.Name === name) || {}; const versions = by(m2, 'Versions Film (2015)'); const ep = by(eps, 'Sample Show S01E03'); if (!view('Movies') || !view('Movies 2') || !view('Shows') || !ep.Id || !versions.Id) throw new Error('not the move sandbox\'s layout'); return { movies: view('Movies'), shows: view('Shows'), plain: by(m1, 'Plain Loose').Id, tagged: by(m1, 'Tagged Loose').Id, looseOne: by(m2, 'Loose One').Id, folderMovie: by(m2, 'Folder Movie (2008)').Id, versions: versions.Id, versionSources: (versions.MediaSources || []).map((s) => s.Id), episode: ep.Id, season: ep.SeasonId };

steps.assert: __vars.inuse.blockers.some((b) => b.code === 'move.in-use' && b.title === 'A file is in use' && !!b.message) && __vars.inuse.again === 'Check again' && __vars.inuse.status.indexOf('blocker') > 0

steps.name: in use: Check again until the other program has closed it
steps.script: const t0 = Date.now(); let tries = 0; while (Date.now() - t0 < 170000) { const n = __lmm.log('/LibraryMaintenance/Move/Plan').length; __lmm.q('.jflm-move-preview-again').click(); tries++; while (!(__lmm.log('/LibraryMaintenance/Move/Plan').length > n && __lmm.settled())) { await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 200)); } if (!__lmm.issues('blocker').some((b) => b.code === 'move.in-use')) { return { tries: tries, ms: Date.now() - t0, blockers: __lmm.issues('blocker').map((b) => b.code) }; } await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 3000)); } throw new Error('still in use after 170 s');

steps.assert: __vars.released.blockers.length === 0 && __vars.released.tries >= 1 && __lmm.state().status === 'It could move there: nothing stands in the way.'
